local data={
	["Originium Ore"]={name="Originium Ore", tier=1, use="A raw formation of Originium unearthed in its most natural form. This can be processed in the AIC.", desc="A basic mineral necessary to support most industrial production.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Originium Mining Spots, Extraction: Mining Rigs, The Hub"},
	["Amethyst Ore"]={name="Amethyst Ore", tier=1, use="An ore containing a purple colored crystalline material. It can be processed with the AIC.", desc="Amethyst has a wide range of uses in precision manufacturing. The crystal is one of the essential basic materials in the electronic industry of Talos-II.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Amethyst Mining Spots, Extraction: Mining Rigs, The Hub"},
	["Ferrium Ore"]={name="Ferrium Ore", tier=1, use="A natural-occurring metal complex with blue coloration. It can be processed with the AIC.", desc="Many theories have been proposed about the origins of Ferrium. Before the age of industrial metallurgy, Ferrium was the most common metal that people used.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Ferrium Mining Spots, Extraction: Mining Rigs, Originium Science Park"},
	["Cuprium Ore"]={name="Cuprium Ore", tier=1, use="A reddish metal that can be processed with the AIC Factory.", desc="A natural mineral complex unique to the Wuling region. Metals acquired by refining this ore form the basis for local industry and production.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Cuprium Mining Spots, Extraction: Mining Rigs, Qingbo Stockade"},
	["Clean Water"]={name="Clean Water", tier=1, use="Pure and clean water. It has plenty of uses in the AIC Factory.", desc="It has always been the source of life.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Extraction: Fluid Pumps, Jingyu Valley"},
	["Precipitation Acid"]={name="Precipitation Acid", tier=1, use="Precipitation Acid is capable of dissolving various chemically resistant materials. It has plenty of uses in the AIC Factory.", desc="Aggeloid remains would turn into a corrosive fluid when subject to abnormal levels of heat and pressure. In the process of Aggeloid formation, Ankhors would simply (and violently) \"mash\" the constituent inorganic materials of an Aggelos together to precipitate various reactions otherwise impossible in the real world. When Aggeloid remains are broken down, these unusual inorganic materials would undergo further changes. This is how the Precipitation Acid is made.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering"},
	["Buckflower"]={name="Buckflower", tier=1, use="A plant with brightly colored flowers that can be gathered from the wilderness or planted in the AIC. Shred it to make medication or materials for other products.", desc="When the War just began, a Hongshan recon team discovered a plant with brightly colored flowers. Extracts of this plant can be used as an anti-hemorrhagic agent.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, The Hub: Construction Site, Plant crops at the Eco-Farm"},
	["Buckflower Seed"]={name="Buckflower Seed", tier=1, use="Seed of the Buckflower. Can be cultivated to grow the plant.", desc="The Buckflower earned its name as it was first found under a natural arch that resembled a bucking, jumping beast.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Firebuckle"]={name="Firebuckle", tier=2, use="A plant with extremely brightly colored flowers that grows in the wild. Can be used for treatment and the making of fine food and medicine (Fine F&M). Firebuckles do not provide seeds.", desc="Buckflowers bloom in mid-April. Plants with the most fiery-red flowers would be called Firebuckles.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, The Hub: Hub West, Chance Gathering: Buckflower, Plant crops at the Eco-Farm"},
	["Citrome"]={name="Citrome", tier=1, use="A fruit  that can be gathered from the wilderness or planted in the AIC. Shred it to make food or materials for other products.", desc="Citromes are part of the botanical genus of Zitros that usually grows in the central continental region of Talos-II. The species and cultivars grown in the Civilization Band tend to yield large fruits with tough, fibrous flesh.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, The Hub: Construction Site, Plant crops at the Eco-Farm"},
	["Citrome Seed"]={name="Citrome Seed", tier=1, use="Seed of the Citrome. Can be cultivated to grow the plant.", desc="Hobby botanists and gardeners of the Civilization Band once voted for the Most Common Plants in the Wildlands. Buckflower and Citromes both made it to the top 10 of the list.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Umbraline"]={name="Umbraline", tier=2, use="A plant with special fruits that grows in the wild. Can be used for treatment and the making of fine food and medicine (Fine F&M). Umbralines do not provide seeds.", desc="Around 12 major Citrome cultivars are currently sold in the markets of the Civilization Band. They come in all sorts of names and offer different juiciness and sugar content. However, they are all Citromes.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, The Hub: Hub West, Chance Gathering: Citrome, Plant crops at the Eco-Farm"},
	["Sandleaf"]={name="Sandleaf", tier=1, use="A plant with extremely rough leaves that can be gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the AIC. Shred it to get a powdered preparation usable in industrial grinding.", desc="The Hannabit Circuit proved themselves as the true masters of wilderness crafting and would use all sorts of natural materials to aid in their crafting.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Power Plateau: Plateau Trunkway, Plant crops at the Eco-Farm"},
	["Sandleaf Seed"]={name="Sandleaf Seed", tier=1, use="Seed of the Sandleaf. Can be cultivated to grow the plant.", desc="The history of wilderness crafting can be traced back nearly a century ago. People forced to live in the wildlands had to do everything they could to survive.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Aketine"]={name="Aketine", tier=1, use="A plant that can be gathered from the wilderness or cultivated in the AIC Factory. It contains flammable and explosive substances and can be used to make Industrial Explosives.", desc="Aketine is a species of flora native to Talos-II. It usually grows at places with unique soil composition.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Valley Pass: Abandoned Trail, Plant crops at the Eco-Farm"},
	["Aketine Seed"]={name="Aketine Seed", tier=1, use="An Aketine seed. Can be cultivated into a new adult plant.", desc="Nitrates can be extracted from Aketine. Scientists believe this is caused by the absorption of rainwater with excessively high levels of Blighted materials.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Jincao"]={name="Jincao", tier=1, use="A plant that can be gathered from the wilderness or planted in the AIC. Shred it to make food or materials for other products.", desc="The jincao plant is commonly known as the \"silkstar grass\", named after the star-like flowers of the plant. The plant usually grows on shaded hillslopes.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Jingyu Valley: Stragglers Grove, Plant crops at the Eco-Farm"},
	["Jincao Seed"]={name="Jincao Seed", tier=1, use="Jincao seed can be acquired by a Seed-Picking Unit. Cultivate it with plenty of Clean Water to grow the plant.", desc="Children in the frontier enjoy blowing two jincao leaves placed together to give off a sound that resembles a roaring beast.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Yazhen"]={name="Yazhen", tier=1, use="A flowering plant that can be gathered from the wilderness or planted in the AIC. Shred it to make medication or materials for other products.", desc="The yazhen plant is an extremely hardy grass native to the Wuling region. The plant produces a rather beautiful bloom during summer.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Jingyu Valley: Stragglers Grove, Plant crops at the Eco-Farm"},
	["Yazhen Seeds"]={name="Yazhen Seeds", tier=1, use="Yazhen seed can be acquired by a Seed-Picking Unit. Cultivate it with plenty of Clean Water to grow the plant.", desc="Yazhen seeds have tiny hooks that aid in their attachment to animal fur for dispersion.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Fluffed Jincao"]={name="Fluffed Jincao", tier=2, use="A special plant that only grows in the wild. Shred it to acquire materials for making food or other products.", desc="Some people in Wuling believe that the jincao plant symbolizes hardiness. Many pieces of local literature use the plant as a metaphor for toughness and survival.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Jingyu Valley: Stragglers Grove, Chance Gathering: Jincao, Plant crops at the Eco-Farm"},
	["Thorny Yazhen"]={name="Thorny Yazhen", tier=2, use="A special plant that only grows in the wild. Shred it to acquire materials for making food or other products.", desc="The thorny leaves of the yazhen plant can be used for angling. A few simple steps and bending would create a very effective angling hook.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Chance Gathering: Yazhen, Plant crops at the Eco-Farm"},
	["Reed Rye"]={name="Reed Rye", tier=2, use="This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be directly used in making quality food and pharmaceuticals.", desc="Reed Rye is a hardy cereal with an impressive yield. It is the staple food of most settlers in the frontier.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Originium Science Park: Cliffside Trail, Plant crops at the Eco-Farm"},
	["Tartpepper"]={name="Tartpepper", tier=2, use="This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be directly used in making quality food and pharmaceuticals.", desc="The leaves of this plant are considered the \"most bitter herbs of the frontier\".", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Originium Science Park: Cliffside Trail, Plant crops at the Eco-Farm"},
	["Redjade Ginseng"]={name="Redjade Ginseng", tier=2, use="This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be directly used in making quality food and pharmaceuticals.", desc="Redjade Ginseng is a mild herb often consumed by people in Hongshan as a fortifying supplement.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Plant crops at the Eco-Farm"},
	["Amber Rice"]={name="Amber Rice", tier=2, use="This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be directly used in making quality food and pharmaceuticals.", desc="The rounded, jade-like endosperm of the Amber Rice is also regarded as \"amber pearls\".", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Plant crops at the Eco-Farm"},
	["Reed Rye Seeds"]={name="Reed Rye Seeds", tier=2, use="Seeds of wild Reed Rye. Cultivate them in available farm plots to raise the crop.", desc="Reed Rye seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Tartpepper Seeds"]={name="Tartpepper Seeds", tier=2, use="Seeds of wild Tartpepper. Cultivate them in available farm plots to raise the crop.", desc="Tartpepper seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Redjade Ginseng Seeds"]={name="Redjade Ginseng Seeds", tier=2, use="Seeds of wild Redjade Ginseng. Cultivate them in available farm plots to raise the crop.", desc="Redjade Ginseng seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Amber Rice Seeds"]={name="Amber Rice Seeds", tier=2, use="Seeds of wild Amber Rice. Cultivate them in available farm plots to raise the crop.", desc="Amber Rice seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.", obtain="Production: AIC Factory Facilities"},
	["Wood"]={name="Wood", tier=1, use="Common wood that can be gathered in the Mossfield region. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="Let's chop down some trees first.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Gatherable: World Exploration"},
	["Glowbug"]={name="Glowbug", tier=2, use="A small flying Originium bug. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="A Talosian creature affected by Originium. These little bugs can give off a gentle glow.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, The Hub: Construction Site"},
	["Scorchbug"]={name="Scorchbug", tier=3, use="A small flying Originium bug with high energy content. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="A Talosian creature affected by Originium. These little bugs can glow and give off a bit of heat.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Originium Science Park: Cliffside Trail"},
	["Burdo-Muck"]={name="Burdo-Muck", tier=1, use="Burdenbeast dung. Can be used as a fertilizer on a planting plot during the growth phase to shorten its growth phase.", desc="Burdo-Muck provides all sorts of nutrients to the soil. If you see a burdenbeast in the wilderness, give it a gentle pat to get yourself a huge, mucking pat of hot, steaming surprise.", obtain="Exploring and Gathering, Interaction Reward: Certain Burdenbeasts"},
	["Inergen"]={name="Inergen", tier=1, use="A stable gas. It has plenty of uses in the AIC Factory.", desc="A special gas that can be purified and extracted using AIC Factory facilities. They said it was first used in pneumatic valves and fittings during the original launching of Dijiang.", obtain="Inergen Vents"},
	["Xiragen"]={name="Xiragen", tier=3, use="The gaseous state of Xiranite. Can be used to produce other materials.", desc="The soil nurtures numerous qi that connects every living being.", obtain="Xiragen Reservoirs"},
	
	["Pingtuber"]={name="Pingtuber", tier=2, use="This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="A special hybrid crop raised in Talos-II. The tubers can be slightly poisonous without proper preparation.", obtain="Farm: Plant Crops, Ingredients Crate, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Pingtuber Cutting"]={name="Pingtuber Cutting", tier=2, use="A cutting of a Pingtuber plant. Cultivate it with crafted farm plots to harvest Pingtubers.", desc="A Pingtuber cutting carefully selected for its generous size and vitality.", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\", Seed-Picking Unit"},
	["Pingtuber Leaf"]={name="Pingtuber Leaf", tier=1, use="A byproduct of Pingtuber cultivation. Can be processed by the AIC Factory to make beast feed.", desc="The leaf of the Pingtuber plant is too fibrous for human consumption.", obtain=" "},
	["Matoberry"]={name="Matoberry", tier=2, use="This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="A new tomato cultivar developed by the UWST Fokka Hydroponic Complex. Matoberries have a well-balanced sweetness and tanginess, making them perfect for soups, stews, and sauces.", obtain="Farm: Plant Crops, Ingredients Crate, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Matoberry Seeds"]={name="Matoberry Seeds", tier=2, use="Seeds picked from Matoberries. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to harvest Matoberries.", desc="Matoberry seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\", Seed-Picking Unit"},
	["Cabbage"]={name="Cabbage", tier=3, use="This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="Common leafy vegetables. These variants have good resistance against the cold after many years of intensive selection.", obtain="Farm: Plant Crops, Ingredients Crate, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Cabbage Seeds"]={name="Cabbage Seeds", tier=2, use="Seeds picked from a cabbage plant. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to harvest Cabbages.", desc="Cabbage seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\", Seed-Picking Unit"},
	["Cabbage (A)"]={name="Cabbage (A)", tier=4, use="This crop is harvested from a Cabbage Plot grown in a crop-refining Xiranite environment. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay. Refined crops are highly prized and rare as they cannot provide seeds that could sustain their quality.", desc="A cabbage of near-perfect quality. The Tianshi of Wuling have great faith in the agricultural applications of Xiranite. This is one of their results.", obtain="Farm: Plant Crops, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Cabbage Seeds (A)"]={name="Cabbage Seeds (A)", tier=2, use="Seeds picked from a Cabbage [A] plant. 	["Crunchcane"]={name="Crunchcane", tier=3, use="This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. 	["Crunchcane Cutting"]={name="Crunchcane Cutting", tier=2, use="A cutting of a Crunchcane plant. 	["Ballpea"]={name="Ballpea", tier=3, use="This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="A special legume unique to Talos-II. They are called \"ballpeas\" as the beans are near-perfect spheres. In fact, some board games often use hard ballpeas as their pieces.", obtain="Farm: Plant Crops, Ingredients Crate, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Ballpea Seeds"]={name="Ballpea Seeds", tier=2, use="Seeds picked from a Ballpea plant. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to harvest Ballpeas.", desc="Ballpea seeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\", Seed-Picking Unit"},
	["Ballpea Pod"]={name="Ballpea Pod", tier=2, use="A byproduct of Ballpea cultivation. Can be processed by the AIC Factory to make beast feed.", desc="Seed pod of the ballpea plant. Breaks with a crunch when pressed hard. Some Tianshi would use the pods as stress relief fidget toys.", obtain=" "},
	["Relishroom"]={name="Relishroom", tier=3, use="This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. 	["Relishroom Spores"]={name="Relishroom Spores", tier=2, use="Spores picked from a Relishroom. 	["Whitemelon"]={name="Whitemelon", tier=3, use="This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. 	["Whitemelon Seeds"]={name="Whitemelon Seeds", tier=2, use="Seeds picked from a Whitemelon plant. 	["Oilseed Bloom"]={name="Oilseed Bloom", tier=3, use="This crop can only be grown with fine cultivation. 	["Oilseeds"]={name="Oilseeds", tier=2, use="Seeds picked from an Oilseed Bloom. Cultivate them with crafted farm plots to harvest Oilseed Blooms.", desc="Oilseeds carefully selected for their generous size and vitality.", obtain="Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\", Seed-Picking Unit"},
	["Meat"]={name="Meat", tier=2, use="A product of ranching. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="A lean and solid chunk of meat. 	["Meat (A)"]={name="Meat (A)", tier=4, use="A product of ranching. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="A perfectly marbled chunk of meat. Please cook it well and don't waste this work of natural beauty.", obtain="Ranch: Raise Beasts, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Milk"]={name="Milk", tier=2, use="A product of ranching. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="Beast milk. It has a slightly gamey taste. Both calves and kids need it to grow up.", obtain="Ranch: Raise Beasts, Ingredients Crate, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Milk (A)"]={name="Milk (A)", tier=4, use="A product of ranching. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="Thick, quality beast milk. Putting it in front of calves and kids might trigger a fight.", obtain="Ranch: Raise Beasts, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Egg"]={name="Egg", tier=2, use="A product of ranching. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="An egg of a Sable-chested Fowlbeast. The eggshell is pretty fragile, so carry it carefully.", obtain="Ranch: Raise Beasts, Ingredients Crate, Shop: Pantry Keep \"Job Rusher\""},
	["Egg (A)"]={name="Egg (A)", tier=4, use="A product of ranching. 	["Fin Fillet"]={name="Fin Fillet", tier=2, use="A product of ranching. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="Fillet from farmed fins. 	["Fin Fillet (A)"]={name="Fin Fillet (A)", tier=4, use="A product of ranching. Can be used to cook food in the Innkeeping gameplay.", desc="Savory and sweet-tasting fin fillet.
